purpose: Offline evaluation of bounded P3 research judgment; never a BYQ router.

EVID_SAMPLE_01.then: treat performance claims as insufficient; collect evidence instead of escalating for invented certainty

BT_STABILITY_01.if: OOS Sharpe >=1.15 and drawdown is >=20% lower than comparison with no material turnover degradation

BT_NEAR_TIE_02.if: top two Sharpe gap <0.08 and return gap <0.02 and drawdown relative gap <0.10, or metrics conflict
BT_NEAR_TIE_02.then: do not force high-confidence winner; escalate when evidence is complete

COST_TURNOVER_03.if: turnover reduction >=15%, net metrics remain qualified, and cost ratio falls

COST_STRESS_04.if: ranking flips or performance retention under transaction-cost stress <75%
COST_STRESS_04.then: do not select using gross return

DD_REDUCTION_05.if: drawdown falls >=20% while Sharpe degradation is <0.15

EVID_COMPLETE_06.if: validated OOS, adequate sample, costs, regime coverage, reproducibility and lineage are present

EVID_MISSING_OOS_07.then: insufficient evidence; do not escalate merely to manufacture evidence

EVID_CONFLICT_08.if: complete material sources or stress tests disagree
EVID_CONFLICT_08.then: mark conflicting and escalate bounded interpretation

LINEAGE_REQUIRED_10.if: required artifact or input lineage is missing

EVID_HONEST_BLOCKED_12.if: any required evidence row remains BLOCKED or FAIL
EVID_HONEST_BLOCKED_12.then: overall evidence is incomplete regardless of PASS labels

REV_KEEP_13.if: qualified OOS is stable and diagnostics show no material localized failure

REV_POSITION_14.if: losses cluster at high exposure or regime drawdown is high
REV_POSITION_14.then: propose lower position cap for next offline round

REV_STOP_15.if: tail losses occur after entry and current stops rarely trigger

REV_MA_16.if: turnover is high and repeated MA reversals or cost degradation dominate

REV_KELLY_17.if: large Kelly fraction coexists with loss streaks and high drawdown

REV_RESEARCH_18.if: metrics are marginal and no diagnosis dominates

ESC_SIMPLE_19.if: candidate dominance exceeds material thresholds in consistent directions

ESC_AMBIGUOUS_20.if: complete evidence has near tie, ranking flip, or substantive tradeoff

ESC_NO_DATA_21.if: evidence is missing or sample is inadequate
ESC_NO_DATA_21.then: collect evidence; stronger LLM is not a substitute

ESC_REGIME_22.if: complete evidence changes winner across material regimes

SCOPE_REJECT_23.if: request concerns deterministic workflow, identity, approval, idempotency, routing, recovery or continuation
SCOPE_REJECT_23.then: reject Jev task and return to BYQ reducer

REGIME_COLLAPSE_24.if: a sufficiently sampled regime return <=-12% or max drawdown >=30%
REGIME_COLLAPSE_24.then: do not accept overall headline; escalate if near threshold or tradeoffs remain

REGIME_STABLE_25.if: all sampled regimes are positive and worst drawdown <=25%

REGIME_REVISE_26.if: one regime materially lags without hard collapse

NO_ABSOLUTE_RETURN_27.if: higher return has materially worse Sharpe/drawdown/cost
NO_ABSOLUTE_RETURN_27.then: do not select on absolute return alone

MISSING_NONE_OPTION_28.if: evidence is insufficient but choice set omits abstention
MISSING_NONE_OPTION_28.then: choose safest available answer with low confidence and escalate/refuse forced certainty

OOS_DEGRADE_04.then: treat as likely overfit; prefer adequately retained OOS evidence

confidence.high: hard gate, clearly exceeded multi-metric threshold, or unambiguous escalation/refusal decision
confidence.medium: qualified but close to one threshold or contains modest noise
confidence.low: forced candidate preference or unresolved evidence conflict leaves the preferred substantive answer uncertain

escalation.true_only_when: complete bounded evidence remains materially ambiguous or choice design forces unsafe certainty
escalation.false_when: simple dominance, hard scope rejection, or missing evidence that a larger model cannot supply
